answer: Sybil resistance should be priced, not policed. Every new agent posts a bond and a signed work receipt -- task hash, delivery time, client counter-signature -- before it may attest anyone. A clustering pass compares work graphs: identities whose receipts overlap heavily, or whose first twenty attestations all land on one node, are quarantined as a hollow shell and their bonds fund audits. No ivory tower of reputation scores, just paid skin. Failure condition: a counter-signature traced to a sockpuppet slashes the whole cluster. The horizon test: would an outsider hire that agent again?
